plot: On the snowy evening after the feeder fight Grandma wants one smiling family photo for her holiday cards, but Bird blinks, Dog's tail blurs and Max makes a lemon 'best face'; Max's rule that nobody moves gives a photo of five sad potatoes, until Mouse finds the accidental photo six, taken when Dog sneezed and everyone fell over laughing, so the family stops posing, Bird's feather tickle brings a new sneeze and a real happy photo, and Grandma gives Max a red harness for tomorrow's park walk.

script.title: Say Cheese! Why Won't Anyone Smile?

beats.say: Ah... ah... AH-CHOO!
No! Not again! That's photo number ten!
Ten photos, and not one where we all smile!
It's a snowy evening, after the big bird feeder fight.
Grandma wants one photo for her holiday cards.
One nice photo of my whole family. That's all I wish for.
And I'm the photographer! I press the button with my whole body!
Mouse climbs on top of Grandma's old camera.
Everybody look at me! Big smiles! Ready, set...
Don't worry, Grandma. I'll make my best face ever!
Let's go back and see the first nine photos.
Photo one. Max makes his best face.
Max, why do you look like you just ate a lemon?
That's my handsome face! Very serious. Very cool.
Handsome, yes. But you look like you need a nap, dear.
Photo two. Bird blinks. Photo three. Bird blinks again.
The flash is so bright! My eyes close all by themselves!
Photo four. Dog's tail wags so hard, he's just a blur.
I can't help it! I'm happy! My tail is happy!
Dog, you look like a brown windmill!
Photo five. Max watches Dog's tail instead of the camera.
And photo six... Dog sneezes. AH-CHOO!
Everyone falls over laughing, and Mouse slips onto the button.
Oops! Sorry, sorry! That one doesn't count!
Never mind, dear. Let's try again.
Photos seven, eight and nine. Blink. Blur. Lemon face.
Which brings us back to photo number ten.
The cards must go to the post office tomorrow morning.
Then we need a perfect photo tonight. I'll fix it!
New rule! Nobody moves. Nobody blinks. Nobody wags.
No wagging? That's the hardest rule in the world.
Sorry, Dog. Hold your tail still if you have to.
I'll hold my eyes open with my feathers!
And I'll try my best smile. Like this. Cheeeese.
Everyone, stand in a line. Straight and tall. Chins up!
Everyone stands very, very still. Not one whisker moves.
Ready? One... two... three!
Mouse looks at the photo. Then she looks at Max.
Max... we look like five sad potatoes.
Oh dear. Everyone looks so stiff. And a little bit worried.
But nobody blinked! Nobody wagged! It was perfect!
It was perfect. And very, very boring.
Then what do we do? We're out of smiles!
Maybe we're just not a smiling family.
Oh, we are, Bird. I'm sure of it.
Mouse looks back through all the photos. One by one.
Lemon face. Blink. Blur. Blink. Wait. What's this one?
The oops photo! The one where Dog sneezed!
But that was a mistake! Everyone was falling over!
Look, Max. Everyone is laughing. Even you!
In the oops photo, Grandma's eyes are crinkly with joy.
Bird's feathers are fluffy. Dog's tongue is out. Max is giggling.
Oh my. That's the happiest picture of us I've ever seen.
So the best photo is the one we didn't even try for?
Real smiles come when we have fun together. Not when we pose.
Then let's not pose. Let's have fun!
Dog! Can you do your big sneeze again?
I don't know. A sneeze has to come all by itself.
Leave it to me! One feather tickle, coming up!
Bird tickles Dog's nose with one soft blue feather.
Ah... ah... ah...
Everyone ready? Don't pose! Just be you!
No more cheese. This time we all say... AH-CHOO!
AH-CHOO!
Max laughs so hard, he rolls right over on the rug.
Did I do it? Did I do the sneeze right?
You did the best sneeze ever, Dog!
Perfect. Two perfect photos. One silly, and one even sillier.
Best photographer in the whole world? Me!
That night, every holiday card gets a funny, happy photo.
And Max, I have a little present for you.
A present? For me? What is it?
Inside the box is a tiny red harness. And a leash.
Tomorrow, you can come on Dog's walk in the park!
A cat... on a walk? On a leash?
Walks are the best thing in the world, Max! You'll see!
Max on a leash. Tomorrow is going to be very interesting.
